lesson.title: Finger Independence and One-Minute Changes
objectives: Move one finger at a time without the others collapsing
Form G, C and D shapes in the air away from the strings
Score a one-minute change count and log it
Beat last session's count by a single change

chords._schema: strings ordered low E (6) to high e (1). frets: null = muted/not played, 0 = open. fingers: 0 = open, 1 = index, 2 = middle, 3 = ring, 4 = pinky, null = muted.

exercises.name: Single-finger lifts inside a held shape
exercises.purpose: Independence: one finger leaves, the rest stay planted.

params.caution: Stop if the forearm aches — short sets only.

exercises.coaching: Only the named finger moves. If a neighbour lifts too, slow down until it stays put.
exercises.qa_status: verified-by-theory-check-2026-08-08 (chord data verified; teaching quality reviewed by author)

exercises.name: Air shapes
exercises.purpose: Build the shape from memory with no strings to lean on.

params.action: Form the shape off the fretboard, then drop it on and check

exercises.coaching: Make the shape in the air, then land all fingers together. Landing together is the skill.
exercises.qa_status: verified-by-theory-check-2026-08-08 (chord data verified; teaching quality reviewed by author)

exercises.name: One-minute change count
exercises.purpose: Turn practice into a measurable, repeatable score.

params.log: write the number down each session

exercises.coaching: Speed first, clean second. Write the number down — next session, beat it by one.
exercises.qa_status: verified-by-theory-check-2026-08-08 (chord data verified; teaching quality reviewed by author)

avatar_coaching_copy.intro: Your fingers move as a team because they have never been asked not to. Today we ask.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex1_intro: Hold C. Lift the ring finger only, put it back. Then middle. Then index. Nothing else moves.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex2_intro: Now off the strings. Build G in the air, drop it on, check it. Then C. Then D.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex3_intro: One minute per pair. G to C, C to D, G to D. Count every completed change.
avatar_coaching_copy.results: Three numbers on paper. Those are your baselines, not your limits.
avatar_coaching_copy.wrap: One finger at a time, shapes in the air, one minute on the clock. Most days beats every day.
